Definition: Jehoash, the name of two Israelite kings
BiblicalUsage: Joash is the name of two Israelite kings, one of Israel and one of Judah. In 2 Kings 11:21, Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign. The fuller story is told on the Joash, King of Judah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Joash is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
